description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Master Mode], [Master Mode: Kefka (Poison)], [Instant ATB 1], [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user.
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Poison/NE magic attacks, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% & Cap Break Level 3/4/5/6/7 to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Poison/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, [True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast & Hero Boost +50%] for 1 turn to user, removes Master Mode

description.name: Master Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed and no cost for the first Soul Break cast, grants [Hero Boost] and sets the Hero Boost level to 1 when set

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999
